login.description: Internal team only. Sign in with an email code, then your authenticator code.
login.footer: Admin accounts are separate from clipper and brand accounts. Lost your authenticator? Ask a super admin to reset MFA.

form.internalNote: Internal note (not shown to the user)

errors.two_person: Another finance admin is required: the creator/requester cannot approve their own.
errors.kyc_not_pending: This user has no pending KYC.
errors.kyc_notify_failed: The KYC decision was saved, but recording & notifying failed. Use "Record & notify user".
errors.batch_not_approved: The batch has not been approved by a second person.
errors.unsupported_type: File must be PDF, JPEG, or PNG.
errors.target_is_admin: Admin accounts can only be changed by a super admin.
errors.cannot_ban_self: You cannot ban your own account.
errors.cannot_reset_self: Your own MFA must be reset by another super admin.
errors.mfa_required: Admin actions require two-step verification. Sign in again.
errors.forbidden: Your admin role is not enough for this action.
errors.invalid_token: Admin session expired. Sign in again.
errors.unauthorized: Admin session expired. Sign in again.
errors.auth_error: Failed to process the account in identity.
errors.storage_error: Failed to store the file or create its link.
errors.file_exists: The same file was already uploaded.
errors.bridge_error: Could not reach the core database.
errors.corrupt_ciphertext: Encrypted data cannot be opened (key mismatch). Contact engineering.
errors.db_error: Identity database error. Try again or contact engineering.

reasons.method_owner_mismatch: Account does not belong to the payee
reasons.no_consent: No consent to share data with the brand

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Platform health today and the work queues for your role.
overview.forbidden: You do not have access to that page. Ask a super admin to add the role.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.description: Review submitted campaigns and build managed packages on behalf of brands.
campaigns.reviewEmptyBody: Campaigns submitted by brands show up here.
campaigns.managedEmptyBody: Brands that chose team assistance show up here, oldest first.
campaigns.approveBody: Only possible once the campaign invoice is paid. The campaign becomes Scheduled.
campaigns.invoiceHidden: Invoice status is visible to finance admins only. Approval is refused automatically while unpaid.

builder.title: Admin builder
builder.pickOrgBody: Pick the brand organisation the campaign is built for. The draft is saved on its behalf.
builder.orgSuspended: This org is suspended: the campaign cannot be saved.
builder.rawBriefNote: Raw brief from the brand; write the structured brief in the Brief step.

pinned.title: Pinned & categories
pinned.description: Pinned campaign order, categories, and home banners. Every change is written to the audit log.
pinned.pinnedBody: Lower rank shows first. Paid pins use an end time without a rank.
pinned.catIdHelp: lowercase letters, digits, dashes (2–30). Cannot be changed.
pinned.bannersBody: Up to 10 banners, shown in order on the home page.
pinned.bannerInvalid: Check the image & link of every banner.

review.title: Submission moderation
review.description: Submissions awaiting review and appeals. Select several, then approve or reject with a standard reason.
review.emptyBody: New in-review and appealed submissions show up here.
review.reasonRequired: Pick a standard reason to reject.
review.appealHint: For appealed submissions: Approve = appeal accepted, Reject = final rejection.

fraud.title: Fraud queue
fraud.description: FR-xx signals per submission, account, or payout, highest score first.
fraud.emptyBody: New flags from the tracking worker and identity show up here.
fraud.payoutHidden: Payout details are visible to finance admins only

actionHelp.reverse: Pending earnings return to the pool and the submission is forfeited. Trust Score −10.
actionHelp.suspend: The account cannot claim/withdraw for 30 days. Trust Score −20.
actionHelp.ban: Permanent ban: pending forfeited, claims released, sessions revoked in identity. Trust Score −50.
actionHelp.dismiss: Signal considered safe; the submission resumes tracking.

users.title: Users & KYC
users.description: Clippers (KYC, Trust Score, bans), brand orgs (verification, fees), and admin accounts.
users.readOnly: Read-only: your role can only view data.
users.kycQueueGap: The KYC queue cannot be listed yet (identity has no queue view). Open a user from search to check their KYC.
users.statusGap: Core account status (active/suspended/banned) is not readable from the api views; core suspend/ban goes through the fraud queue.
users.banBody: Identity refuses refresh tokens; already-issued tokens stay valid ≤ 10 minutes. The core profile status does not change.
users.kycNoAccess: KYC data is for moderators, support, and finance only.
users.kycReadFailed: Failed to read KYC data from identity.
users.kycNone: The user has not submitted KYC.
users.ktpMissing: The ID card photo could not be loaded.
users.ktpModeratorOnly: The ID card photo is visible to moderators only.
users.kycApproveBody: Make sure the photo, name, and NIK match. The user is notified.

kycReasons.name_mismatch: Name does not match the ID card
kycReasons.nik_invalid: NIK does not match the ID card
kycReasons.not_ktp: Not a genuine ID card photo
kycReasons.duplicate: NIK/bank account used by another account

users.notifyPending: The identity decision is not yet recorded in core / not yet sent to the user.
users.kycAudit: Every time KYC data is opened it is logged in the identity audit.
users.ownerKycNoAccess: Owner KYC status is readable by moderators/support/finance only.
users.orgRejectBody: The brand fixes the data in org settings and resubmits.
users.orgSuspendBody: The org's campaigns cannot be saved/submitted while suspended.
users.invitePicBody: Send an account invite to the PIC's email, then add them to the org with this role.
users.addMemberBody: For an existing account (identity user ID).
users.setFeeBody: Fill only what changes; empty follows the global fee.
users.adminListGap: The admin list cannot be shown yet: identity has no api view for platform roles (E-27).
users.inviteAdminBody: A new admin account (separate from clipper/brand accounts) + initial role.
users.setRoleBody: Applies from the next token (≤ 10 minutes).
users.resetMfaBody: Delete all of the user's TOTP factors; they enrol again at next sign-in.

finance.title: Finance
finance.description: Incoming brand payments, weekly payouts (two-person), instant, refunds, and the PPh 21 recap.
finance.incomingHint: Match against the bank statement in internet banking. The amount must equal the total; a reference number cannot be used twice.
finance.amountHelp: Amount short → do not confirm, contact the brand.
finance.createBatchBody: Collect requested batch payouts up to the cut-off. Another finance admin must approve the batch.

batchStep.draft: Step 2: another finance admin approves the batch.
batchStep.approved: Step 3: export the bulk transfer CSV (15-minute link).
batchStep.exported: Step 4: mark the transfer result per payout.
batchStep.paid: Step 5: upload the transfer proof to close the batch.

finance.needSecondPerson: You created this batch — ask another finance admin to approve it.
finance.markHint: Failed → balance returns to the clipper.
finance.uploadProofBody: PDF/JPEG/PNG, max 10 MB. The batch closes once the proof is stored.
finance.proofHelp: PDF, JPEG, or PNG · max 10 MB
finance.heldBody: Held at export (account/KYC) or by fraud. Cancel to return the balance to the clipper.
finance.cancelPayoutBody: Funds + fee return to the clipper's Available balance.
finance.instantHint: Hanging instant payouts are retried automatically every 15 minutes; provider responses are not exposed to admins yet.
finance.refundHint: Approved by a finance admin other than the requester. After transferring, upload the proof to mark it paid.
finance.refundProofBody: Transfer {amount} to the brand's account, then upload the proof.
finance.pph21Body: Gross paid payouts per person + NIK + ID card name (the tax team computes the tax).

fulfillment.title: Non-cash fulfillment
fulfillment.description: Non-cash reward claims queued per reward type.

kindHelp.manual_export: Export recipient data and send it to the brand/vendor. Only users who consented to data sharing are included.
kindHelp.code_pool: Voucher codes are assigned automatically from the pool.
kindHelp.webhook: Sent automatically to the brand's webhook; repeated failures appear as alerts.

fulfillment.deliveredGap: There is no admin action yet to mark manual-export claims as delivered.
fulfillment.codesGap: Codes can only be uploaded by the owner/manager of the brand that owns the reward type (api.upload_reward_codes).
fulfillment.cancelBody: The balance returns to the clipper. Voucher codes already assigned cannot be cancelled.

config.title: Config
config.description: Fees, hold, withdrawals, polling, claims, referral, feature flags, community, billing account. Every change is logged before/after.
config.readOnly: Read-only: only super admins can change config.
config.valueJsonHelp: Must keep the same type as the old value.
config.feesBody: The global fee applies when an org/campaign has no override.
config.feeOverrideBody: Fill only what changes; tick to remove the override.
config.lockedBody: The identity issuer is changed through the Phase 0 migration, not from admin.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Every admin, finance, and config action in core: who, what, when, before/after.
audit.identityGap: The identity PII access log (member.audit_logs) has no api view yet, so it is not shown here.

broadcast.title: Broadcast
broadcast.description: Announcements to clipper segments. Promotional email follows user preferences.
broadcast.segmentHelp: Leave everything empty = all active clippers. Platforms = has a verified account on any of them.
broadcast.activeDaysHelp: Has a claim/submission within N days
